Name: Agent Deck
Description: Codex Micro-style control surface for the Codex desktop app: live agent status keys, accept/reject/new-chat command keys, one-tap workflow skills, and a reasoning-effort dial.
Author: Thomas Burgess

Actions.Name: Agent Status Key
Actions.Tooltip: Live status of a Codex thread (idle / working / needs input / done). Press to open it.

Actions.Name: Command Key
Actions.Tooltip: Accept, reject, interrupt, new chat, push-to-talk, or a custom command sent to Codex.

Actions.Name: Skill Key
Actions.Tooltip: Fire a preset workflow prompt (review PR, debug, refactor, ...) into Codex.

Actions.Name: Reasoning Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Cycle Codex reasoning effort (model_reasoning_effort in config.toml).
